scope: Independent mathematical/source review of the parent-authored generic orthonormal affine frame projection and scalar Gaussian density module.
findings: The finite sum of orthonormal normal-coordinate projections is in the actual normal span. Its residual is orthogonal to every generating frame vector and hence to their span, giving the genuine orthogonal projection by uniqueness.

The actual affine frame point is Z+g-P_S(g). Equal normal spans and equal actual Z therefore yield pointwise equality of affine section points, including frames of different finite sizes for the point identity.
Orthonormality gives exact norm(Z)^2=sum_i a_i^2. Expanding the actual scalar Gaussian densities yields (sqrt(2pi)^-1)^q*exp(-norm(Z)^2/2), with the normal rank q and no ambient-dimensional factor.

For two same-size orthonormal frames with the same actual normal point, density products are exactly equal. No Gaussian coarea law or desired derivative/mass equality is assumed by these algebraic geometric lemmas.
qualifications: This checkpoint proves pointwise projection/frame and density identities. It does not alone assert native-coordinate Gaussian section/coarea transport or final codimension-three incidence/quantitative H.1 aggregation.
execution_observation: Checkpoint 6 records successful build, forced source elaboration, and strict 6-target axiom audit.
